All Core Devs - Consensus (ACDC) #160, July 10, 2025

- [Jul 10, 2025, 14:00 UTC](https://notime.zone/OTnjM50IKk2qo)

# Agenda 

- CL releases with updated gas limit values
- Fusaka
  - `fusaka-devnet-2` status
  - `fusaka-devnet-3` spec
    - https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1598#issuecomment-3057334966
    - https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/674
    - https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/pull/123
    - open issues with BPO or validator custody?
    - devnet launch date?
  - Road to mainnet
    - cf. https://blog.sigmaprime.io/shipping-peerdas.html
    - get stable devnet-3 then shift to hardening implementations
    - BPO schedule proposals
- Glamsterdam
  - Select 1 CL headliner on 24 July
    - n.b. only 1 headliner per layer
  - headliner discussion

**Telegram Notification**
- Updated message for this occurrence to Ethereum Protocol Updates channel

Hey, Mark from Lighthouse would like to discuss EIP-7732 (EPBS) as the headliner for Glamsterdam. Can likely be done with no change to agenda -- just referencing his blog post here https://blog.sigmaprime.io/glamsterdam-headliner.html.

📅 ACDC #160 X/Twitter Stream: https://x.com/i/broadcasts/1LyxBWdPXnpKN

📣 Promote ACDC Meeting 160 on X/Twitter: http://bit.ly/3U2FAYB

Know its EL; but can we get a confirm if the CLZ and tx gas cap changes are in devnet3?

https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9986
https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9987

Were discussed on ACDT; but not sure if they are devnet3 confirmed (vs a devnet4)

Would like to add this refinement to the fusaka-devnet-3 spec: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/674.

For CL clients this would simply mean:
- rolling back to V2 behaviour **prior** to this change: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/671 (i.e. V2 goes back to returning all-or-nothing, guaranteed).
- no-op, if the above change was not implemented in the first place.

No need for CL to consume V3 for now.

> Know its EL; but can we get a confirm if the CLZ and tx gas cap changes are in devnet3?
> 
> [ethereum/EIPs#9986](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9986) [ethereum/EIPs#9987](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9987)
> 
> Were discussed on ACDT; but not sure if they are devnet3 confirmed (vs a devnet4)

There are no plans to have devnet 4. 

They were included last call to be part of devnet 3. 

Its all on the spec sheet notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/fusaka-devnet-3

We are just waiting for the PRs to be approved by a few more people and get them merged in.
